label: Asia and the Gulf build rival crypto blocs against the Clarity Act
description: Asia refusing to let America become the crypto capital of the world and going its own way against the Clarity Act, with the Middle Eastern countries doing the same, all of it leading back to the same pot, with very rich men at a table of businessmen and bankers deciding which currencies they will support and back. He says he does not know when, and assumes the president is still in office.

label: A fertiliser truck at the Hoover Dam, to flood Nevada
description: A mass power event or a McVeigh-style bombing aimed at national infrastructure, with substations in major cities taken out, nuclear facilities targeted, and a massive dump truck of fertiliser at the Hoover Dam to flood Nevada. He asks on air how much it would take and notes the dam generates electricity, so the reasoning is his rather than given.
aliases: I saw Hoover Dam with a massive dump truck
Timothy McVeigh stuff, fertilizer, to flood Nevada
I saw nuclear facilities that were being targeted

label: A bridge into Manhattan split in the middle with cars going into the water
description: A major disruption on a bridge between New York and New Jersey going into Manhattan, split in the middle, with cars going off the side into the water, seen alongside a presidential motorcade on the road. The bridge is not named, and only a handful carry road traffic between New Jersey and Manhattan, which makes the target list short enough to check.
aliases: the one that goes to New York to New Jersey area
it was split in the middle and cars were going off the side

label: A hit list running from least to greatest, to kill American officials
description: A strategic list held by Middle Eastern men described as Iranian special operations rather than ordinary soldiers, ordered from least to greatest importance, of American government figures to eliminate in return for their own generals, with attacks planned on the vehicles around the president rather than his own. He later prays over a named set including broadcasters, a cabinet officer and the president's adult children.
aliases: from less importance to more importance to eliminate them out of the government
attacks not on his in the beast, but on people that were in the suburbans

label: A charismatic forked-tongue figure like Obama sways even believers
description: A darkness settling in with a new Obama-type spokesman, who he wonders may profess to be Republican, a charismatic figure with a forked tongue who plays on race and on the Spanish-speaking vote and will sway even believers, with the New York result offered as the pattern. Nobody is named, which is what keeps it from being scoreable.
aliases: a new type of Obama spokesman
a charismatic forked tongue person is coming
Look what happened in New York

label: America changed almost to a rewriting of the Constitution, under a dark umbrella
description: A dark agenda in which America is completely changed, almost a complete rewriting of the Constitution, described as among the darkest things he has seen, with a dark umbrella coming over the nation. He adds that a few determined people will not stop it because it is about the heart of a nation as a whole, which supplies the reason for any failure.
